crossRefs.note: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.
For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’
For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
“If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;
if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,
“By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.
Here I am. Witness against me before Yahweh, and before his anointed. Whose ox have I taken? Whose donkey have I taken?…
They said, “You have not defrauded us, nor oppressed us, neither have you taken anything from anyone’s hand.”
to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
“Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I…
He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
Don’t exploit the poor, because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were…
If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t…
The people of the land have used oppression and exercised robbery. Yes, they have troubled the poor and needy, and have…
Listen to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy…
But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of…
A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and…
To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,
There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.
There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.
You shall speak to him, saying, ‘Yahweh says, “Have you killed and also taken possession?” ’ You shall speak to him…
For the vineyard of Yahweh of Armies is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for…
Woe to those who join house to house, who lay field to field, until there is no room, and you are made to dwell alone…
They covet fields, and seize them; and houses, and take them away: and they oppress a man and his house, even a man and…
You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing…

translations.web: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.
translations.bsb: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor; he has seized houses he did not build.
translations.kjv: Because he hath oppressed and hath forsaken the poor; because he hath violently taken away an house which he builded
translations.asv: For he hath oppressed and forsaken the poor; He hath violently taken away a house, and he shall not build it up.
